features.name: AL namespace field in All Objects with Captions table
features.description: A new text 500 field called AL namespace has been added to the All Objects with Captions table in BC27, providing visibility into the namespace of each AL object.
caveats: The field is not visible on the standard page 9174 in the base application, but can be added via page extension since the page is extensible

features.name: Record ID formatting with AL namespace
features.description: Record ID variables can now be formatted to display the fully qualified AL namespace of the record using format type 9, showing which namespace a record belongs to.

features.name: Record ID evaluation against fully qualified namespace
features.description: Developers can now evaluate a Record ID variable against a specific fully qualified namespace to test whether a record belongs to a particular namespace.
